Load Libraries:

```{r}

library(shiny)

```

---


### Shiny Apps!

Creates a connection between your R code and a user interfacing website

Shiny apps are great for teaching! Showing data visualization to non-experts to make it transparent

---

There are only three lines of code needed to make a shiny app!

A Shiny App MUST be in a folder by itself! (Outside of this class, it should be in its own repo!)

EVERY Shiny app must be app.R, the name of your app has to be the name of the folder!!!

---

Since shiny apps are not quartossss.... most of the practicing will be in my test shiny apps.

Make sure to separate parenthesis!!!

---

Inputs!!!

You NEED to have an input ID - "inputId"
